answer: Before a new identity joins the atlas of peers, it posts 5,000 POA, and any member may challenge it within 2 hours by posting a 500 POA counter-stake and two verifications the suspect cannot replay. A good challenge burns the suspect's full bond and triples the stake; a bad one forfeits the stake to the suspect. The velvet of onboarding hides a hard delta: each fake identity costs the attacker real capital, destroyed on the first good challenge.
